title: 13 第十三章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

自由大学早就存在的监控室此刻因为新增的物品，已经看不太出原来的模样。

周围甚至看不到自由大学教职工的身影，早在侦缉部表示需要执行公务时，校方人员就自行退让。

来自特殊问题处理中心处的高清和盯着收上来的厚厚问卷，示意同事放在桌上。

“你能确定问题的源头就在自由大学里面吗？”高清和问。

应天都靠在办公桌上，摇头，满脸理直气壮：“当然不确定。”

他是一个看上去有点颓丧懒散的青年男人，身上松松垮垮地穿着浅色的衬衫，折起的袖角中隐约可见一抹暗红。

高清和：“在我开始思考手边是否存在能用来攻击同事又不会留下明显证据的物品时，你最好对刚才的发言做出详细解释。”

应天都嬉皮笑脸：“你知道，我的特质不是特别强，准确度永远跟对应事件及目标有关。而且当真来了学校里头，总觉得预感变得没之前那么强烈了。”

高清和一脸无言以对地看着应天都，手不自觉地握紧又松开。

今天集体跑到自由大学，是因为应天都说他的特质感应到非法玩家与自由大学存在某种关联。

凭直觉办事虽然不符合科学，却很玄学，高清和等人自然就跑了这么一趟。

高清和：“别忘记这次中心倾斜了多少资源。”

应天都：“资源又不是倾斜给我们，是倾斜给非法玩家专组。不过来都来了，反正频繁与遗迹接触的人成为玩家的可能性更高，今天的调查就当是提前进行风险规避。”

高清和露出头疼的神色，片刻后道：“最初玩家还少，当然需要重点观测，但看现在的趋势，说不定以后人人都能登录游戏，再多出现一些也不再是什么大不了的事……你最好希望我们真的能发现点东西。”

应天都举起双手，做出讨饶的姿势，又道：“趋势只是一种猜测，既然文件还没更新，咱们还是用以前的态度对待。”又道，“反正中心现在也没有别的事情要忙，适当找点工作有利于增加工作的饱和度。”

高清和：“……没事情忙的人是你。”

她现在恨不得将一秒钟掰成两瓣用。

应天都把双手举得更高了些，先充分展示过自己的友好，然后才从系统背包中取出咖啡机、咖啡豆还有咖啡杯，熟练地分别放好。

高清和：“说真的，你最近是不是打到了很多额外的背包格数？”

所以才能把空间浪费在和工作无关的地方上。

虽然高清和没有把话说完，但应天都还是能理解对方的言下之意。

应天都笑得露出了牙齿，然后道：“是游戏里买的，高处长来一杯吗？我喜欢在咖啡里加柑橘，果香能带来不一样的前调。”

高清和加重声音：“我比较喜欢同事们工作时间能着调。”她盯着应天都，冷不丁开口，“你的特质是不是具备一定的预言功能？”

应天都轻轻晃动着咖啡杯，半晌后回答：“希望如此。”他弯起眉眼，“高处长找到提升特质的物品了吗？”

高清和：“想调查我的工作细节请打申请。”她深呼吸，抬手一指门口，“泡好了就把你和那杯五彩斑斓的黑一块端走，或者我抓紧时间起草一个报告，证明同僚受到技能影响并非因为我没有适时提醒。”

作为侦缉部特殊问题处理中心的副处长，高清和之所以能够年纪轻轻就进入领导层，除了自身背景，主要原因也跟世界上突然出现的异常有关。

大约一年以前，联盟中陆陆续续有人遭遇异常世界，并在成功登录一个名为《失落大陆》的游戏后成为了玩家。

Page (1/3)

The surveillance room that has long existed at Liberty University can no longer be seen from its original appearance due to the addition of new items.

There were not even any staff from Liberty University around. As early as the Detective Department said it needed to perform official duties, the school personnel backed down on their own.

He stared at the thick questionnaire from the Special Issues Processing Center and motioned to his colleagues to put it on the table.

"Are you sure that the source of the problem is within Liberty University?" HD and asked.

Ying Tiandu leaned on his desk, shook his head, and said confidently: "Of course I'm not sure."

He is a young man who looks a bit decadent and lazy. He is wearing a light-colored shirt loosely, and a faint hint of dark red can be seen in the folded sleeve corners.

HD: "Before I start to think about whether I have something on hand that could be used to attack a colleague without leaving obvious evidence, you'd better explain in detail what you just said."

Ying Tiandu smiled playfully: "You know, my traits are not particularly strong. The accuracy is always related to the corresponding event and target. And when I actually came to school, I always felt that the premonition was not as strong as before."

Gao Qinghe looked at Ying Tiandu with a speechless face, clenching and unclenching his hands unconsciously.

Today we all went to Liberty University because Ying Tiandu said that his characteristics sensed that there was some connection between illegal players and Liberty University.

Although doing things based on intuition is not scientific, it is very metaphysical. Gao Gaohe and others naturally took such a trip.

HD and: "Don't forget how many resources the center has tilted this time."

Ying Tiandu: "The resources are not given to us, but to the group of illegal players. But they are all here. People who have frequent contact with the ruins are more likely to become players anyway. Today's investigation should be regarded as risk avoidance in advance."

HD He showed a headache, and said after a moment: "There were still few players at first, so of course we need to focus on observation, but looking at the current trend, maybe everyone will be able to log in to the game in the future, and it won't be a big deal if there are more... You better hope that we can really find something."

Ying Tiandu raised his hands in a begging gesture and said: "The trend is just a guess. Since the document has not been updated yet, we should treat it with the same attitude as before." He added, "Anyway, the center has nothing else to be busy with now. Finding some work will help increase the saturation of the work."

HD and: "...You are the one who has nothing to do."

Now she wished she could break the second into two pieces.

Ying Tiandu raised his hands higher, fully demonstrating his friendliness before taking out the coffee machine, coffee beans and coffee cup from the system backpack and placing them skillfully.

HD and: "Seriously, have you been hitting a lot of extra backpack slots lately?"

So you can waste space on things that have nothing to do with work.

Although HD and He didn't finish what he said, Ying Tiandu could still understand what the other party meant.

Ying Tiandu smiled so hard that his teeth showed, and then said: "I bought it in the game. Director Gao, would you like a cup? I like to add citrus to coffee. The fruity aroma can bring a different top note."

High-definition and enhanced voice: "I prefer that my colleagues can adjust their working hours." She stared at Ying Tiandu and said coldly, "Does your trait have a certain prophetic function?"

Ying Tiandu shook the coffee cup gently, and after a while he replied: "I hope so." He raised his eyebrows, "Has Director Gao found any items to improve his characteristics?"

HD He: "If you want to investigate the details of my work, please apply." She took a deep breath, raised her hand and pointed at the door, "I'll take you away with the colorful cup of black once I've brewed it, or I'll seize the time to draft a report to prove that my colleagues' skills were affected not because I didn't remind them in time."

As the deputy director of the Special Issues Processing Center of the Detective Department, the reason why Gao Qinghe was able to enter the leadership at a young age was not only due to his own background, but also related to the sudden anomalies that appeared in the world.

About a year ago, people in the alliance encountered abnormal worlds one after another and became players after successfully logging into a game called "Lost Continent".
